vc_checking.summary: All nine cleaned manual witnesses are semantically provable under the current annotation and case_lib. The IsFull returns follow directly from the branch guards and CircularAreaIsFullResult; the KPrintf pure obligation is a zero-offset identity; the two safety obligations follow from CircularAreaDescriptorState bounds; and the three data-length returns follow by combining CircularAreaIsFullResult with the matching branch of CircularAreaDataLengthResult or CircularAreaErrorResult. Spatial resources are unchanged and can be framed/cancelled. No helper declaration or annotation/spec repair is required.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Choose a valid top-level entailment disjunct, preprocess/cancel unchanged spatial resources, unfold one of the four annotation-approved mathematical predicates, split the branch relation, and discharge explicit guards, descriptor bounds, contradictions, or reflexive result equalities.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: All targets either preserve GlobalStrings alone or carry an unchanged descriptor/buffer/global-pointer frame; no spatial resource must be synthesized, split, or transformed.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: CircularAreaIsFullResult and CircularAreaDataLengthResult branches are selected by explicit branch hypotheses; descriptor conjuncts give nonzero and signed-difference bounds; literal/error identities normalize reflexively.
analysis_groups.shared_refinement_plan: not applicable; all targets are direct proofs and contain no safeExec state
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: The nine targets share the same case-local predicates, unchanged-frame entailment pattern, and direct pure proof style. They fit under the 12-witness limit, and one worker can prove them sequentially without cross-group helpers or dependency ordering.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: For each witness, unfold the witness definition and choose a convenient top-level disjunct. Introduce quantified hypotheses, use standard separation-logic preprocessing/cancellation for the unchanged GlobalStrings/descriptor/buffer frame, and unfold only the relevant seed predicate. For IsFull returns choose the result-relation branch fixed by readidx/writeidx/b_status. For the KPrintf pure witness normalize the zero pointer offset. For safety_wit_7/8 unfold CircularAreaDescriptorState and solve nonzero and signed-difference bounds from 0 <= indices < area_length <= 256. For DataLength return_wit_1 exclude the full IsFull branch using retval = 0 and select the modular-distance result branch; for return_wit_2 exclude the non-full branch using retval <> 0 and select the full-length branch; for return_wit_3 unfold CircularAreaErrorResult. Close exact result equalities reflexively. No helper or forbidden lemma is needed.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: All obligations state that already-owned resources are preserved while the concrete branch result satisfies the mathematical ring-buffer predicates. The guards and descriptor invariant supply every pure premise; the result expressions are definitionally the same as the predicate branches.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: Same case, same two mutually connected result predicates, same descriptor invariant, same unchanged-frame/direct-proof pattern, no helper family or dependency boundary, and nine witnesses are within the controller maximum of twelve.
